dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got hungry the moment I stopped...

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Hehe. That's quite common, I assure you.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: That's why you need to pause and check on yourself from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Hiia
dialogues.text: Come on, have a little grub and rest a bit. Only then can you give yourself the best start for the next leg of your journey.
